extractable_text: On the afternoon of the incident, the Payments API experienced elevated latency. Customers reported slow checkout. The on-call engineer was paged and mitigated the issue by restarting the affected pods. Root cause was a connection pool exhaustion triggered by a deploy. See the attached latency chart for the incident timeline. A follow-up action item was created to add pool-size alerting.
visual_only_facts: The latency spike lasted roughly 10 minutes, from minute 20 to minute 30
